As a science and innovation company, we believe that diverse teams are stronger teams. We are committed to fostering a culture of curiosity and courage, where you can grow your career with a company that has innovation in its DNA. Founded on creating real-world impact to enable a better future, we strive to provide an open, collaborative culture where diversity of thought is encouraged and respected. Hear from our employees about what it's like working at Avery Dennison. Learn more at www.averydennison.com.At Avery Dennison, we work with the biggest brands in the FMCG, apparel, automotive, and pharma industries. Our Rodange Site Avery Dennison Luxembourg Sàrl location, founded in 1989, is a collaborative and dynamic environment that supports our Label and Packaging Materials Group division and employs approximately 540 talented individuals. Key functions at this site include Operations, Customer Service, central teams and various support functions, offering diverse career paths and opportunities for growth.

Job ID: 10529667 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) organization owns Amazon's global inventory management systems: we decide what, when, where, and how much we should buy to meet Amazon's business goals and to make our customers happy. We do this for millions of items, for hundreds of product lines worth billions of dollars of inventory world-wide. We foster new game-changing ideas, creating ever more intelligent and self-learning systems to maximize the efficiency of Amazon's inventory investment and placement decisions.
The Automated Inventory Management team within SCOT seeks an experienced and motivated Business Intelligence Engineer to develop analytical models and tools to automate the auditing of the SCOT systems. Such tools may include algorithms, metric bridges, dashboards, processes and workflow systems.

The successful candidate will have strong quantitative data mining and modeling skills and be comfortable working on new and sometimes ambiguous problems from concept through to execution. They will have strong communication and leadership skills, will be able to collaborate with other teams (e.g. software development, business owners, product managers) and to present findings to senior audiences to drive business improvements. As well we expect this candidate to raise the bar on any of the following categories: Data Warehousing, Data Architecture, Performant Self Service Toolsets and Data analytics. Candidate might be willing to work with the others BIEs in order to solve organizational problems at scale and setting the grounds of a healthy data products offer while delivering what is required by business.

Key job responsibilities

• Performing complex analysis to understand the behavior of automated inventory management systems, identify the root cause of system / process issues and provide insight on potential solutions.
• Building audits (analytical products) to identify trend breaks or defects at scale for millions of products and multiple Marketplaces globally
• Assessing the end-to-end suite of audits and identifying opportunities for enhancements and simplification, working with other audit owners
• Creating new solutions to automate the business process of identifying and resolving defects (e.g. through metric dashboards and automated alarms, self service dashboard, Single source of truth tables... )
• Supporting the improvement of the automated audit workflow system: integrating new audits and providing input on the future developments/roadmap
• Developing dashboards and insight products
• Fostering culture of continuous engineering improvement through blueprints, mentoring, feedback, and metrics

Basic Qualifications

• Experience in analyzing and interpreting data with Redshift, Oracle, NoSQL etc.
• Experience with data visualization using Tableau, Quicksight, or similar tools
• Experience with one or more industry analytics visualization tools (e.g. Excel, Tableau, QuickSight, MicroStrategy, PowerBI) and statistical methods (e.g. t-test, Chi-squared)
• Experience with scripting language (e.g., Python, Java, or R)
• Experience with SQL
• Experience in the data/BI space

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree, or Advanced technical degree
• Knowledge of data modeling and data pipeline design
• Experience with statistical analysis, co-relation analysis

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you're applying in isn't listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Fund Legal Senior Officer – CDI (m/f)
description:
Title:  Fund Legal Senior Officer – CDI

Dept:  FUND LEGAL DEPARTMENT

Description:

The Fund Legal Department is in charge of company secretarial tasks, internal control and corporate governance for the Cayman Islands domiciled subsidiaries of NBL as well as monitoring of the legislation and regulations applicable to our business activities. The Fund Legal Department is also responsible for the legal work in relation to the set-up, restructuring and liquidation of the Cayman investment funds administered by NBL.

In order to support the department, we are looking for a legal officer on a permanent contract.

Your main tasks will be:

• Organize the board meetings for our two Cayman subsidiaries (GFTC/MTC),  Ensure the related documentation is collected, drafted, shared, signed and registered appropriately
• Coordinate and liaise with the team and lawyers for the execution and delivery of legal documents
• Draft and review GFTC/MTC's corporate governance policies and procedures. Control NBL polices applicable to GFTC/MTC.  
• Draft various regulatory reporting to Cayman authorities.
• Conduct the risk assessment of the third-party service providers (e.g. external law firms)
• Assess various invoices from the third parties.
• Assist the team to perform certain fund projects (setting up, restructuring and termination of funds).
• Safekeeping of original documents and database maintenance

Job requirements:

• Successful candidates must possess either: (a) an academic background in Studies in Law, with a preference for Luxembourg, European, and/or UK common law jurisdictions. Experience in a legal environment would be a plus; or (b) a minimum of three years of professional experience within a law firm or a legal department of financial institutions or equivalent entities
• Familiar with laws and regulations applicable for global financial institutions
• General knowledge of company secretary functions for companies and internal control
• A collaborative mindset and willingness to share administrative tasks and operational responsibilities with team members to ensure smooth departmental operations.
• A keen interest in offshore jurisdictions, with a specific focus on Cayman Islands fund structures.
• Very good level of English. In particular, advanced English writing skill is essential
• Good legal drafting and analytical skills; attention to details,
• Strong organizational and time-management skills, with a track record of meeting strict deadlines
• Sound judgment in compliance with laws and regulations as well as common sense and commercial reasonability
• Proactive with stress resilience and hands-on approach
• Good communication skills in English (French is a plus), open-mindedness, and flexibility to adapt to an international and multicultural office environment

Please be aware that in accordance with the law of July 23, 2016, the selected candidate will be requested to provide a criminal record (section 3)

If you are interested in this position and meet the job requirements, please apply by clicking on our Nomura Recruitment Gateway.

title: Expert Ressources Humaines (m/f) (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? title: (Senior) Risk Manager (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))

description:
Willkommen im Team als

(Senior) Risk Manager

Das Unternehmen:

Die Commerz Real Fundmanagement S.à r.l. (“CRFM“) ist ein Spezialist für die Verwaltung von Alternativen Investmentfonds. Die CRFM trägt hierdurch zum Profil der Commerz Real AG und ihren Konzerngesellschaften (“Commerz Real Gruppe“) als integrierter Investmentdienstleister bei. Die CRFM arrangiert Alternative Investmentfonds, insbesondere für Immobilien, Infrastrukturprojekte, Anlagen zur Erzeugung erneuerbarer Energien sowie Großmobilien (wie z.B.: Flugzeuge, Schiffe und Schienenfahrzeuge). Die CRFM ist eine Tochtergesellschaft der Commerz Real AG, die ihrerseits eine Tochter der Commerzbank Aktiengesellschaft, Deutschland, ist.

Aufgabe:

- Als (Senior) Risk Manager Anlageprodukte und Teil des Risk Management Teams bist Du verantwortlich für die Risikoanalyse, Bewertung und Überwachung von (komplexen) Neu- und Bestandsgeschäften unter Beachtung von wirtschaftlichen, rechtlichen und steuerlichen Rahmenbedingungen hinsichtlich aller relevanten Risikoarten (u.a. Adressausfall-, Objektwertänderungs-, Marktpreis-, Liquiditätsrisiken, spezielle Risiken im Bereich Infrastructure wie z.B. Betriebs- und Projektentwicklungsrisiken, etc.)
- Dabei stellst Du die kompetenzgerechte Genehmigung bzw. Erstellung von Genehmigungsvorlagen für An- und Verkaufstransaktionen der AIF/Spezial-AIF sicher
- Zu Deinen Aufgaben gehört auch die Mitarbeit bei der Strukturierung und Steuerung von AIF/Spezial-AIF zur haftungsmäßigen und wirtschaftlichen Optimierung
- Ebenso verantwortest Du die regelmäßige risikotechnische Überwachung der AIF/Spezial-AIF im Wertschöpfungsprozess inkl. Überwachung der vertraglichen Finanzierungsgestaltung und des Liquiditätsmanagements
- Du unterstützt die Marktbereiche bei Vertragsverhandlungen im Neu- und Bestandsgeschäft sowie bei der Entwicklung von neuen Produkten als Mitglied in Dealteams und/oder Projektgruppen
- Die Leitung von bzw. Mitarbeit in bereichsinternen Projekten zur Optimierung / Digitalisierung der Risikoorganisation, hier insbesondere zur (Weiter-)Entwicklung von gesetzeskonformen Prozessen, Regularien und Risikotools gehört ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben
- Du bringst Deine Expertise und Unterstützung bei übergreifenden Projekten sowie im Rahmen der Digitalisierungsstrategie ein. Dabei übernimmst Du auch die Leitung von übergreifenden Projekten
- Du übernimmst Coaching / Weiterbildungsaufgaben im Risikomanagement sowie die Ausbildung von Nachwuchskräften

Profil:

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes (auch berufsintegriertes) Studium mit der Fachrichtung Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder Rechtswissenschaften, idealerweise im Schwerpunkt Risikomanagement
- Langjährige fachbezogene Berufserfahrung im Bereich Risikomanagement eines Asset-Managers, eines Fondsemissionshauses oder eines Kreditinstitutes,
- Umfassende Kenntnisse und mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Assetklasse Infrastructure, idealerweise auch in Private Equity und Debt Strukturen. Grundkenntnisse und Interesse an den Assetklassen Renewable Energies, sowie Real Estate runden Deine Erfahrung ab.
- Erweiterte betriebswirtschaftliche Kenntnisse insbesondere im Bereich Risikomanagement, Bilanzanalyse, Discounted Cash-Flow-Analyse, Sensitivitätsanalyse, Cash-Flow-Modellierung, Liquiditätsrisikomanagement und Portfoliosteuerung
- Sehr gute Kenntnisse der einschlägigen Gesetze, Verordnungen, Vorschriften und Richtlinien (AIFM-Richtlinie, AIFM-VO, ESMA-Leitlinien, Luxemburger Gesetze bzgl. AIFMD, u.a.)
- Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und sehr sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
- Gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, idealerweise auch gute Französischkenntnisse
- Ausgeprägte Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Hohes Maß an Zielstrebigkeit und Eigeninitiative sowie unternehmerisches Denken und Flexibilität

Its solutions are largely based on unit-linked insurance policies, serving the needs of affluent, high net worth (HNW), and ultra-high net worth (UHNW) individuals.

Your responsibilities will be as follows:

• Act as the person of contact for partner and client queries received by email, post or by telephone in respect of client data management,

As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender, colour, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Consultant BI (m/f)
description:

La particularité de ce profil réside à combiner de solides compétences dans l'écosystème SAP Business Intelligence avec des compétences en Data Science, Machine Learning et Intelligence Artificielle.

Vos missions :

En fonction des projets et des besoins de nos clients, vous pourrez intervenir sur différentes étapes de la chaîne Data :

SAP Business Intelligence

• Participer à la conception et à l'évolution de solutions BI dans l'environnement SAP.
• Intervenir sur SAP BW/4HANA et SAP BusinessObjects.
• Concevoir et maintenir des rapports et tableaux de bord avec SAP BusinessObjects Web Intelligence (WebI).
• Participer à la modélisation et à la structuration des données.
• Utiliser SAP Information Design Tool pour la conception et la gestion des univers.
• Analyser les besoins métiers et les traduire en solutions BI.
• Participer à l'amélioration et à l'optimisation des solutions de reporting existantes.

Data Engineering & ETL

• Participer à l'extraction, la transformation et l'intégration des données.
• Travailler sur des environnements SAP Data Services et SSIS.
• Manipuler différentes bases de données : MySQL et SQL Server.
• Préparer et nettoyer les données nécessaires aux analyses.
• Participer à la mise en place de flux de données fiables et exploitables.

Data Science & Machine Learning

• Explorer et analyser des jeux de données complexes.
• Préparer et transformer les données pour les modèles analytiques.
• Développer des modèles de Machine Learning.
• Participer à des travaux de prédiction, classification, régression et optimisation.
• Utiliser les bibliothèques Python dédiées à la Data Science et au Machine Learning.
• Évaluer les performances des modèles et interpréter les résultats.
• Explorer les possibilités offertes par l'Intelligence Artificielle dans les problématiques métiers de nos clients.

Data Analytics & Visualisation

• Réaliser des analyses statistiques et exploratoires.
• Identifier les tendances, corrélations et informations pertinentes dans les données.
• Construire des visualisations permettant de faciliter la compréhension et l'exploitation des données.
• Participer à la conception de tableaux de bord et d'indicateurs de performance.
• Utiliser Power BI ainsi que les outils de visualisation Python.

Votre profil :

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'un Master en Data Science, Intelligence Artificielle, Business Intelligence, Informatique, Statistiques ou dans un domaine similaire.

Vous disposez d'une première expérience professionnelle significative dans les domaines de la BI, de la Data/ de l'IA.
Nous recherchons avant tout une personne capable de comprendre les problématiques métiers et de faire le lien entre données, outils BI et technologies Data/IA.

Au-delà de la maîtrise des différents outils, votre valeur ajoutée réside dans une double approche SAP BI et Data Science / IA.
Vous devez comprendre les problématiques traditionnelles de Business Intelligence et de reporting, tout en ayant une vision plus large des possibilités offertes par la Data Science, le Machine Learning et l'Intelligence Artificielle.

title: PhD CANDIDATE IN SOCIAL CRITERIA DRIVEN ABSOLUTE ENVIRONMENTAL.... (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 48 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

The Environmental Sustainability Assessment and Circularity (SUSTAIN) Unit conducts cross disciplinary research to support the transition toward a more sustainable, resilient, and healthy society. SUSTAIN combines expertise in environmental sciences, circular economy, risk and safety assessment, and sustainable innovation to address complex challenges related to human and environmental health, climate change, and resource efficiency, developing knowledge, methods, and transferable software for the simulation and comprehensive sustainability assessment of socio-economic systems. Its purpose is to foster sustainable eco-innovation, through products and technologies, as well as support sustainability-oriented policy implementation and behavioural change to promote decarbonisation transitions.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The world faces a convergence of crises that are transforming the conditions for human development. Climate instability, ecosystem degradation, and the overuse of natural resources have reached critical levels, while social inequality, political fragmentation, and technological disruption are reshaping societies. Traditional notions of economic competitiveness, centred on growth and productivity, are being redefined to include social resilience, inclusiveness, and ecological integrity. Responding to this “polycrisis” requires new pathways that reconcile prosperity with planetary and social limits. Luxembourg offers a particularly illustrative example of these tensions. The country enjoys one of the highest income levels globally and a dynamic financial and business environment that sustains its reputation for economic success. Yet this prosperity depends strongly on cross-border commuting, which creates mobility challenges and environmental stress. Escalating housing prices have made access to affordable living increasingly difficult, displacing a significant share of the workforce beyond national borders. The reliance on imported energy leaves households and firms vulnerable to external shocks. Although Luxembourg's welfare model and social dialogue remain robust, they are under pressure from rising costs of living, widening inequalities, and growing demands on public services. Environmentally, Luxembourg's footprint per inhabitant ranks among the largest worldwide, driven by high consumption and land-use pressures that push the country beyond sustainable limits.

Meeting these intertwined challenges calls for coordinated transformations that bridge sectors, disciplines, and scales. Economic and social progress must be reframed within the concept of a Safe Operating Space—an area in which human well-being is achieved without breaching environmental boundaries. The objective is to steer innovation, governance, and everyday practices toward forms of competitiveness that are compatible with sustainability, rather than in conflict with it. The Doctoral Training Unit C-SOS (Competitiveness within a Safe Operating Space) is designed to cultivate researchers capable of analysing and fostering such transformations. It brings together an interdisciplinary consortium to train 12 PhD candidates in the assessment and design of inclusive and sustainable development trajectories. The programme equips them with conceptual and methodological tools to connect environmental sustainability, social well-being, and economic dynamics into integrated frameworks for decision-making. Its ambition is to inform socio-economic policies, encourage responsible industrial and technological innovation, and contribute to more equitable and resilient societies. Luxembourg provides an ideal environment for this initiative, combining strong expertise in sustainability science and policy analysis. The DTU is a collaboration between researchers at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST), the University of Luxembourg (UL) and the Urban Development and Mobility Department at the Luxembourg Institute of Socio-Economic Research (LISER). The consortium also includes the National Statistics Office (STATEC). In this DTU, 12 scientists will train 12 PhD students over six years (from January 2027), each obtaining a PhD from UL's doctoral schools.

As part of the C-SOS Doctoral Training Unit, in this PhD you will integrate concepts from Post-Growth, Sufficiency and Doughnut Economics into the downscaling of planetary boundaries, leveraging good examples of application to territories and cities. Possible research questions include: how to couple ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system? How to define social foundation? How to allocate the carrying capacity based on social foundation?.

You will be embedded in the SUSTAIN unit at LIST and enrolled as a doctoral candidate at the University of Luxembourg. You will work closely with a diverse cohort of 12 PhD researchers across the social, economic, and environmental sciences, contributing to a shared research agenda on how Luxembourg can thrive within its fair share of planetary limits

You will be mainly in charge of:
• Conducting a systematic review and critical assessment of existing carrying capacity allocation and planetary boundary downscaling approaches, spanning economic and emission based allocation methods, sufficiency based approaches, and Doughnut Economics frameworks
• Developing a methodological framework for coupling ecological limits and social foundation as an interdependent system, integrating Post-Growth, Sufficiency, and Doughnut Economics concepts into the downscaling of planetary boundaries
• Applying the framework to Luxembourg and comparable small territories under a range of allocation scenarios, drawing on Green Deal technology targets, context specific Decent Living Standards, and provisioning systems, producing environmental ceiling estimates grounded in social foundation thresholds

employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Fixed term contract | Belvaux | 24 months

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO) that drives innovation for the economy and society in Luxembourg and beyond. With cutting-edge expertise in Natural, Built, Industrial environments, Space, AI, Security and defence technologies. LIST bridges scientific excellence and applied research to design solutions that address real-world challenges and create positive impact.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

The push to reduce global energy consumption has set a clear trend in modern technology towards devices that are smaller, faster and more energy-efficient. Meeting these demands calls for new materials that can perform several functions at once. Magnetoelectric multiferroics are especially attractive in this respect, because they combine magnetism and ferroelectricity in a single phase. Crucially, this opens the possibility of controlling magnetism with an electric field which could enable entirely new device architectures and transform modern computing and data storage. Despite decades of progress, this promise is hard to realise: in most known multiferroics the two orders only coexist well below room temperature, and many are difficult to integrate with standard semiconductor manufacturing. Turning multiferroics into a practical technology therefore requires identifying or designing new materials that show robust, coupled magnetism and ferroelectricity at room temperature and remain compatible with established fabrication processes.

This is the challenge at the heart of the SMART project funded by the FNR CORE programme and led by Natalya Fedorova. We offer a 2-year postdoc position in which you will use first-principles calculations (DFT) together with analytical modelling to design room-temperature multiferroics via doping of semiconductors. Working mainly with DFT, you will carry out a systematic analysis of electronic, structural, magnetic and ferroelectric properties of these materials - computing, for instance, ground-state magnetic configurations, magnetic exchange interactions, electric polarization and polarization-switching pathways. You will then combine these results with analytical models to describe the magnetoelectric coupling in the most promising candidates and to explore how their magnetism could be manipulated with an applied electric field.

You will join the Modelling of Functional Materials group led by Jorge Íñiguez-González (also involved in the project) and will benefit from interactions with other team members.

How will you contribute?
You'll be working on a production-grade Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) system purpose-built for second-level controls on NAV computation in investment funds. The system must retrieve relevant regulatory methodology, replicate calculation steps, detect discrepancies against fund accounting outputs, and produce control reports that are traceable, auditable, and defensible under regulatory scrutiny.
You will contribute to a system where precision, explainability, and reliability are non-negotiable.

Code Development (60%):
·          Build retrieval pipelines optimised for structured regulatory methodology documents (CSSF circulars, ESMA guidelines, fund prospectuses), with adaptive weighting to surface the specific calculation rules relevant to each control query
·          Implement numerical validation pipelines that compare LLM-derived NAV calculation outputs against fund administrator figures, applying configurable tolerance bands and discrepancy flagging logic
·          Implement chunking strategies optimised for fund accounting reports and regulatory circulars, preserving the structure of calculation tables, formula references, and numbered regulatory provisions.
·          Build evaluation frameworks measuring control accuracy (error detection rate, false positive/negative rates on flagged discrepancies) and the quality of generated audit reports
·          Optimise vector database indexing for regulatory document corpora with high update frequency, ensuring fast retrieval as new CSSF/ESMA guidance is published

Research & experimentation (25%):
·          Benchmark embedding models against the current Nomic Embed Text baseline, with a focus on sensitivity to numerical and regulatory language in fund accounting contexts
·          Explore cross-lingual retrieval for EU regulatory documents published across multiple languages, with emphasis on French and German variants of CSSF and ESMA guidance
·          Research agent-based simulation of NAV calculation steps, investigating how LLMs can reason reliably over arithmetic-sensitive regulatory workflows and signal confidence levels
·          Experiment with multi-agent orchestration for second-level control workflows, where agents decompose a NAV control task into parallel verification sub-tasks across pricing, accruals, and corporate actions.

System integration (15%):
·          Integrate LLM backends optimised for structured reasoning and develop prompt engineering patterns that enforce step-by-step calculation verification and explainable output
·          Implement comprehensive logging, structured audit trail generation, and monitoring dashboards that allow compliance officers to review and challenge control decisions

description:

Temporary contract | 14+22(+12) months | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us
The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?
You will be part of the LIST Materials Research and Technology department, where you will carry out your work in the Quantum Materials Group, led by Dr. Florian Kaiser.
Quantum technologies have the potential to revolutionise the world in many aspects. Quantum colour centres in in wide bandgap semiconductors have recently emerged as a promising platform, since they can incorporate quantum systems, which can be scaled up by industrial processing. Along these lines, we have recently shown that individual colour centres can be integrated into silicon carbide nanophotonic waveguides with little-to-no degradation of spin-optical coherences. These finding define the strategy for developing a scalable quantum technology architecture.
Our strategy is to use multiplexed and integrated colour centres for quantum communication tasks. Key here is to generate entanglement between colour centres based on spin-photon entanglement, as well as Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. With this milestone demonstration, we strive to kickstart subsequent developments towards a quantum internet architecture.

The objective of this PhD thesis is to support our work towards optical interference between colour centres, i.e., Hong-Ou-Mandel interference. The initial part of this thesis comprises setting up our new optical cryostat platform, which is based on a combination of standard confocal microscopy, and interferometry. In the second step, you will benefit from our ongoing activities towards quantum photonic silicon carbide chips in which we generate colour centres in fibre-coupled waveguides.
You will determine the ideal pulsed excitation schemes for colour centres, considering spectral, temporal and polarization filtering. Subsequently, you will characterise the photon quality depending on experimental parameters, and implement initial two-photon inteference experiments outside of the cryostat, followed by a fully-on-chip demonstration inside the cryostat. If time permits, this project can be further extended to the generation of entanglement between two colour centre chips located in two different cryostats.

How will you contribute?

LIST is seeking to recruit a two-year postdoctoral position to work on fabrication of the piezoelectric energy harvester based on ceramics for tires. This position is part of the Strategic Research Program “Tire as a sensor” in the joint project with Goodyear SA and explores how to transform mechanical energy from tires to a useful electrical energy, which can power tire sensors. The approach used for energy harvesting is the piezoelectric effect. Materials which show piezoelectric properties transform strain variation into electrical charge. These materials can be ceramics or polymers. The material chosen in this study is commercial PZT ceramics. To efficiently use the available mechanical energy in tires and induce strain in the piezoelectric material, it is essential to develop an adapted harvester's design, the transducer. In addition, harvester's signal conditioning plays an important role. To harvest enough electrical energy, all three points: material properties, harvester design and signal conditioning, have to be addressed.

This Postdoc position is mainly focused on development of energy harvester based on ceramics. Several challenges will be addressed to achieve targeted values of power from tires:
·        Investigation of geometries for an efficient transfer of strain from the tire into the ceramic. The design optimisation will be done using finite element modelling (Comsol)
·        Development/adaptation of signal conditioning electronics
·        Integration of the harvester into a real tire
·        Tests in the tire in operation

title: HR BUSINESS PARTNER (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
HR-26001 HR BUSINESS PARTNER

Permanent contract | Belval

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a leading Research and Technology Organisation (RTO), bridging scientific excellence and applied research to address real-world challenges. With over 840 employees - more than 70% of whom are researchers, engineers, and PhD-level professionals working across Natural & Built Environments, Industrial Technologies, Space, AI, Security and Defence.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website.

How will you contribute?

Our HR team of 20 professionals covers the full spectrum: HR Administration, Talent Acquisition, Learning and Development, HR Projects, and HR Business Partnering. This last function currently comprises two HRBPs. Following continued organisational growth and increasing complexity, we are creating a third HRBP position - not to replace someone, but because the demand is real.

The role

The HR Business Partner operates with a high degree of autonomy under the general supervision of the HR Director.
This is an individual contributor (IC) role - you will not manage a team, but you will lead by influence, advise with authority, and build lasting relationships within a public research institution.
You will be the primary HR point of contact for a defined population of managers and employees (e.g. Head of Units, Group Leaders, Service Heads), supporting them across the full employment lifecycle — from recruitment validation to exit interviews, from salary review to contractual management. You will work side-by-side with HR Admin, Talent Acquisition, and L&D, but the accountability for your internal "client" perimeter is yours.
This is not a role where you execute a playbook. It is a role where you read the situation, navigate the rules, and find the right path - always within a well-defined legal and regulatory framework.

What you will actually do

Here is what you will spend your time on:

1. Conflict Management & Difficult Situation Advisory

This is the most demanding dimension of the role - not in volume, but in complexity, emotional weight, and reputational stakes. Your approach is fundamentally advisory: you coach managers on how to prevent tensions from escalating, and when a situation has already become critical, you guide them through a structured, legally sound resolution process. You distinguish between what requires immediate intervention and what requires patience. You document carefully, advise precisely, and remain steady when those around you are not. Working with highly educated, articulate professionals means that the people on both sides of a conflict are often skilled at constructing their argument - your job is to remain the clearest, calmest voice in the room.

2. Manager Coaching

You act as a trusted sounding board for managers navigating team dynamics, people decisions, and leadership challenges. This is not change management in the programme-delivery sense - it is the daily, relational work of helping managers think through situations, anticipate consequences, and gradually build their own HR reflex. You build your influence over time, not through authority, but through consistency, credibility, and genuine availability.

3. Recruitment Facilitation & Internal Mobility

You are the HRBP anchor in the recruitment process for your perimeter: framing needs with Hiring Managers, contributing to the annual recruitment plan, and supporting internal mobility decisions. You do not own the end-to-end recruitment process - that is the Talent Acquisition team's remit - but you ensure the right organisational decisions are made at the right moments.

4. Trial Period & Contract Monitoring

You actively track trial periods, flag risks early, and organise structured feedback conversations between managers and employees. You manage end-of-trial-period decisions with rigor and care. You conduct or facilitate exit interviews and ensure that what can be learned is captured. You have a genuine appetite for contractual matters - including the nuances of employment situation.

5. Luxembourg Employment Law - Applied Advisory

You are a reliable reference point on Luxembourg labour law and its practical application: CNS procedures (reclassement, medical visits), parental and family leave frameworks, absence management processes, and dismissal procedures. You do not just cite the rule - you contextualise it, assess the risk level, and give the manager and HRD actionable guidance, always within the legal and regulatory framework.

6. Annual Salary Review

You coordinate and manage the annual salary review cycle for your client perimeter, ensuring internal equity, policy compliance, and a smooth process across managers, HR Admin, and Finance. You are comfortable working with data - building and maintaining Excel dashboards, producing pivot-table-based analyses, and transforming raw data into clear decision-support materials for management. Advisory skills.

7. Performance Management Support

You oversee the annual appraisal cycle and provide advisory support to managers on objective-setting and performance conversations, ensuring process consistency - while remaining in an advisory capacity rather than a direct participant in those discussions.

8. HR Department Contribution

You contribute to collective HR objectives, participate in cross-functional initiatives, and actively represent the HR team's values in every interaction with your internal clients. You communicate through influence - not authority - and you understand that in a public institution, relationships are built slowly and lost quickly.

The Environment

We want you to know what you are signing up for:

Your internal clients are highly educated. Many are PhD-level professionals who are rigorous, analytical, and used to evidence-based reasoning. Vague HR advice will not land. You must be precise, credible, and consistent.
This is a public research institution. That brings strengths - stability, mission-driven colleagues, and genuine intellectual depth - as well as challenges: governance layers and decision cycles that differ from those in smaller organizations.
Flexibility is key. LIST operates across multiple research domains with matrix-like reporting lines and evolving team structures. You will frequently need to act without the full picture being settled.
The tooling is pragmatic, not perfect. Office 365 is your daily environment.
Proactive, not reactive. The best HRBPs here anticipate - they may notice a manager struggling before it becomes a case, they flag a contractual risk before it becomes a dispute. Structured foresight is expected.
You will need to be visible. Open-space team, occasional presence across LIST sites. Being accessible and visible matters here.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Must-haves

At least 5 years of HR experience after Bachelor's degree or 3 years after Master's degree in Human Resources, with a substantial portion in a generalist HRBP or HR advisory role - you have operated independently, ideally not as support to a more senior HRBP
Proven conflict management and employee relations expertise - you have coached managers through difficult situations, both preventively and curatively, from first signal to resolution
Solid knowledge of Luxembourg employment law in practice (CNS, absences, dismissals, parental leave, etc).
Genuine appetite for contractual matters - you find contract drafting, amendment, and employment nuances interesting, not burdensome
Excel proficiency at pivot-table level minimum - you can produce clean, decision-ready reporting and work with compensation or absence data without requiring handholding
Fluency in both English and French (written and spoken) - both languages are in daily use
A diplomatic, influence [...]

title: RESEARCHER ENGINEER IN AUTOMATION OF POWER CONVERTER DOMINATED GRIDS (m/f)
employer: Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology - LIST
description:
Temporary contract | 24 months | Belvaux

Are you passionate about research? So are we! Come and join us

The Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) is a Research and Technology Organization (RTO) active in the fields of materials, environment and IT. By transforming scientific knowledge into technologies, smart data and tools, LIST empowers citizens in their choices, public authorities in their decisions and businesses in their strategies.
You will join the Intelligent and Clean Energy Systems (ICES) research unit at the Luxembourg Institute of Science and Technology (LIST) and will actively contribute to the WeForming and EnerTEF project, funded by the Horizon Europe, in collaboration with research institutes and Industrial partners around Europe.

WeForming and EnerTEF focus on the use of Inverter-Based Resources (IBRs) in smart grids. In the case of WeForming, this includes the integration of energy storage systems together with smart electric vehicle chargers, while EnerTEF focuses on establishing Testing and Experimentation Facilities (TEFs) for the energy sector. Specifically, this project leverages industrial communication networks, distributed controllers, AI models, and state-of-the-art IBR-based infrastructure to optimize EV charging and energy systems. By integrating distributed energy resources, demand response, and storage, this project aims to enhance grid flexibility and increase the use of renewable energy.

Do you want to know more about LIST? Check our website: https://www.list.lu/

How will you contribute?

• Automating the operation and control of real demonstrators based on IBRs, including BESS, EV chargers, and PV generation, using distributed controllers (e.g. Beckhoff/TwinCAT, NI/CompactRIO, SIMATIC/PAC) and industrial communication protocols (e.g. Modbus, IEC 61850, EtherCAT, OPC UA, CAN/CANopen).
• Deploying cloud-to-edge architectures for real-time operation of IBR-dominated grids, integrating edge controllers with cloud platforms (e.g. AWS or GCP) using wide-area and publish–subscribe mechanisms (e.g. MQTT, AMQP, REST APIs, OPC UA).
• Implementing distributed control strategies, including advanced services from grid-forming IBRs.
• Working with RT-HIL environments (e.g. OPAL-RT, Typhoon, dSPACE) to validate cloud-controlled systems interacting with real hardware.
• Participating in experimental activities in laboratory and field demonstrators with real-time data exchange and actuation.
• Disseminating results through technical publications and contributions to national and European RDI projects.

Is Your profile described below? Are you our future colleague? Apply now!

Education
• A PhD's or MSc degree in electrical engineering, automation, computer science, or a related discipline, with proven expertise in the operation and control of smart grids.
Experience and skills
• Solid hands-on experience in designing and deploying automation and control architectures involving IBRs, distributed controllers, communication networks, SCADA, and cloud-based platforms.
• Experience in projects using cloud-based platforms (e.g. AWS, GCP), containerized services (Docker, Kubernetes), and middleware brokers (MQTT, OPC-UA, AMQP) to interact with distributed controllers.
• Practical knowledge of distributed control systems and real-time operation of smart and active distribution grids, including IBRs for battery storage, PV, and hybrid DERs.
• Familiarity with grid-forming control principles, converter modelling and deployment of real-time distributed responses to improve grid conditions.
• Experience with RT-HIL platforms (e.g. OPAL-RT, Typhoon), including closed-loop interaction with real hardware and field devices.
• Strong programming skills in Python, C/C++, and experience with data-centric control and monitoring architectures.
• Experience working in interdisciplinary RDI environments and contributing to experimental demonstrators (lab and field).
• Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills suited for both technical and collaborative work.
Language skills
• Good level both written and spoken English

Your LIST benefits

• An organization with a passion for impact and strong RDI partnerships in Luxembourg and Europe that works on responsible and independent research projects
• Sustainable by design, empowering our belief that we play an essential role in paving the way to a green society
• Innovative infrastructures and exceptional labs occupying more than 5,000 square metres, including innovations in all that we do
• An environment encouraging curiosity, innovation and entrepreneurship in all areas
• Personalized learning programme to foster our staff's soft and technical skills
• Multicultural and international work environment with more than 50 nationalities represented in our workforce
• Diverse and inclusive work environment empowering our people to fulfil their personal and professional ambitions
• Gender-friendly environment with multiple actions to attract, develop and retain women in science
• 32 days' paid annual leave, 11 public holidays, 13-month salary, statutory health insurance
• Flexible working hours, home working policy and access to lunch vouchers
• Access to state-of-the-art facilities, including the ICES RT-HIL simulation laboratory.
• Collaboration opportunities with leading researchers and industry partners in the EnerTEF project and beyond

title: Supply Chain Environment Specialist (m/f)
description:
At Vodafone, we're working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.
Join Us

At Vodafone, we're not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we're shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you're part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What you'll do

The Supply Chain Environmental Specialist supports the development and delivery of Vodafone's environmental strategy across supply chain categories and markets. The role focuses on category-level climate transition planning, supplier engagement, emissions reduction, and capability building within procurement, ensuring purchased goods and services align with Vodafone's 2030 reduction milestones and 2040 Net Zero ambition.
The role sits within Vodafone Procure & Connect (VP&C) in Luxembourg and reports into Vodafone Group's Sustainable Business Team, which sets global sustainability strategy and partners with business units to drive delivery. This is a growing and high-impact area, offering the opportunity to work with sustainability and supply chain experts while engaging a wide range of stakeholders across markets and functions. The role requires a self-driven individual with strong communication and programme management skills, comfortable creating new ways of working.

1. Category climate transition strategies

Support the development of category-specific climate transition plans aligned to Net Zero 2040.
Conduct baseline assessments to identify emissions hotspots, risks, opportunities, and KPIs.
Embed environmental criteria into category planning to support long-term decarbonisation.

2. Procurement collaboration & decision-making support

Support the implementation of sustainable procurement processes, including environmental requirements and contract terms.
Partner with category managers to embed carbon reduction targets, environmental KPIs, and climate-aligned supplier selection.
Provide climate data, insights, and analysis to support responsible sourcing decisions.
Support ESG assessments within RFQs, guiding suppliers and integrating results into scoring models.

3. Supplier engagement & performance management

Manage supplier performance against ESG contractual commitments and KPIs.
Drive supplier alignment with Vodafone's environmental targets, reporting, and transition pathways.
Issue and track supplier improvement plans, escalating risks where required.
Participate in supplier reviews to support credible decarbonisation and improved environmental performance.

4. Capability building for procurement teams

Deliver training, tools, and guidance to strengthen environmental capability across procurement.
Develop templates, guidance, and onboarding materials covering KPIs, carbon methodologies, and assessments.
Facilitate workshops and learning sessions to embed sustainability into BAU procurement activities.

5. Environmental data, reporting & governance

Support consolidation and validation of supplier climate data for category strategies, CSRD, and internal reporting.
Maintain category-level environmental KPIs and provide progress updates to leadership.
Provide accurate and timely supply chain environmental data to Group Finance.
Who you are

    Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Business, Logistics, Sustainability, or a related field. A Master's degree is an advantage.
    4+ years of experience in supply chain, procurement, sourcing, supplier management, logistics, or a related discipline, with exposure to complex stakeholder environments and cross-functional collaboration.
    Strong project management and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, interpret complex data sets, identify risks, and drive informed decision-making.
    Experience engaging and influencing suppliers and internal stakeholders, including Procurement, Finance, Operations, and Sustainability teams, to deliver business and sustainability objectives.
    Demonstrated ability to support supplier negotiations, supplier performance management, and risk mitigation initiatives, leveraging data-driven insights to improve outcomes.
    Strong understanding of procurement processes, category management, sourcing strategies, contract compliance, and supplier engagement practices.
    Proven track record of identifying and implementing process improvements, standardisation initiatives, and operational efficiencies within supply chain or procurement functions.
    Proactive, collaborative, and highly detail-oriented approach to problem-solving, with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
    Knowledge of supply chain sustainability principles, including circular economy, reverse logistics, responsible sourcing, ESG considerations, and supplier sustainability programmes.
    Passion for environmental sustainability, climate transition, Scope 3 emissions reduction, supplier ESG performance management, and circularity initiatives.
    Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and data analysis tools. Experience with ERP/MRP systems, reporting tools, and process automation is highly desirable.

Not a perfect fit?

Worried that you don't meet all the desired criteria exactly? At Vodafone we are passionate about empowering people and creating a workplace where everyone can thrive, whatever their personal or professional background. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align exactly with every part of the job description, we encourage you to still apply as you may be the right candidate for this role or another opportunity.
What's in it for you

We want you to feel happy and fulfilled at work, without compromising the other things in life that matter to you. Here are some of the ways we support this:
Annual Discretionary Bonus
•    Rewarding your hard work and dedication
Generous Annual Leave
•    28 days of annual leave, with the option to buy an additional 5 days and the opportunity to carry over 5 days per year
•    1 additional day (Family Day) for personal milestones or special occasions
•    11 public holidays to enjoy time with family and friends
•    5 charity days per year to give back to the community
Flexible Work Arrangements
•    Flexible working schedule to help you balance your professional and personal life
•    20 days to work from abroad, allowing you to combine work with travel and new experiences
Comprehensive Health and Wellness
•    Lunch vouchers to support your midday meals
•    Access to private AXA health insurance and a robust pension scheme to secure your health and future
Continuous Learning and Development
•    Access to Vodafone University and online training resources to help you grow your skills and advance your career

description:
Für einen internationalen Technologie- und Entertainment-Kunden in Malta suchen wir koreanischsprachige Kandidaten für eine kundenorientierte Online-Rolle in einem professionellen Studio-Umfeld.
Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – eine umfassende Schulung wird angeboten.

We are recruiting Korean-speaking Online Presenters / Customer Service Representatives for a global technology company based in Malta.

In this role, you will work from a professional studio environment, engaging with online users and delivering a high-quality, interactive digital experience. No previous experience is required — full training is provided.

Key Responsibilities

- Host and present interactive online sessions from a live studio
- Engage with users in a professional, friendly, and customer-focused manner
- Maintain high presentation and service standards at all times
- Participate in internal initiatives and promotional activities
- Follow company procedures and quality standards
- Report any operational or technical issues to supervisors
- Maintain a clean and professional working environment

Requirements

- No previous experience required – full training provided
- Fluent Korean
- Conversational English (B1 or above)
- Willingness to work a 24/7 rotating shift pattern (including weekends and public holidays)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment

Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Up to €400 monthly performance bonus
- €400 annual wellness allowance
- Night shift allowance
- Monthly transport allowance (€70)
- Monthly food allowance
- Retention allowance
- Life insurance (2x annual salary)
- Private health insurance from day one
- Free access to on-site gym
- Company events and social activities
- Snacks and fruit provided at the workplace

Note: German language skills are not required. Relocation to Malta is supported.

30 augustus 2026 Maastricht University
WO
limburg, Maastricht
Geplaatst 9 uur geleden
Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. You will also examine how liver metabolism influences their toxicity. For selected extracts, you will use chemical analyses such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS to help identify the compounds responsible for the observed effects. title: PHD Candidate Towards a Tiered Risk Assessment Strategy
description:
PhD Candidate Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Welcome to Maastricht University!
Would you like to help detect health risks in herbal food supplements earlier, using data-driven approaches? Herbal supplements are often considered safe because they are natural. But how well do we actually understand their potential health effects? In this PhD project, you will develop a testing strategy to identify possible hazards earlier and contribute to safer use of herbal supplements.
PhD Candidate: Towards a tiered risk assessment strategy to evaluate the safety of herbal supplements
Herbal food supplements are widely used and often perceived as inherently safe because they are 'natural'. Yet these products can contain complex mixtures of bioactive compounds, and their composition may vary depending on the plant material, extraction method and production process. Contamination, adulteration and differences between batches add further uncertainty. Because these products are generally not tested before entering the market, potential adverse effects may only become apparent once they are already widely used.
That is why a robust and structured strategy is needed to better evaluate the safety of herbal supplements and reduce potential risks to human health. In this collaborative project, you will investigate the hepatotoxicity, nephrotoxicity, genotoxicity and endocrine-disrupting potential of diverse herbal extracts using human-relevant in vitro models and complementary bioassays. You will also examine how liver metabolism influences their toxicity. For selected extracts, you will use chemical analyses such as LC-MS/MS and GC-MS to help identify the compounds responsible for the observed effects. The complementary PhD project at Utrecht University will investigate other potential adverse health effects, including neurotoxicity, cardiotoxicity and effects on the blood-brain barrier.

- Schnittstellenmanagement:  Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern aus dem Marketing und dem Management der Apotheke entwickeln Sie erfolgreiche Wachstumsinitiativen für das eCommerce-Geschäft der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. - Sie verfügen über eine technische oder technisch-kaufmännische Ausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Fluidtechnik, Maschinenbau oder Automatisierungstechnik.
- Sie bringen Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb erklärungsbedürftiger Produkte mit.
- Sie kommunizieren sicher in Deutsch und Englisch, weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
- Sie arbeiten eigenständig, strukturiert und überzeugen durch ein professionelles Auftreten beim Kunden.
- Sie besitzen Verhandlungsgeschick sowie ein gutes technisches Verständnis für industrielle Anwendungen.
- Reisebereitschaft innerhalb der BeNeLux-Region sowie idealerweise ein Wohnsitz in den Niederlanden.

Was unser Kunde bietet:

- Flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit hoher Eigenverantwortung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum im internationalen Vertrieb.
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel sowie eine strukturierte Einarbeitung in Produkte, Prozesse und Märkte.
- Spannende Kundenprojekte im industriellen Umfeld mit langfristiger Perspektive.
- Ein wertschätzendes, mittelständisch geprägtes Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen.
- Attraktive Vergütung sowie individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Was wir bieten:

- Persönliche Beratung und individuelle Begleitung während des gesamten Bewerbungsprozesses.
- Zugang zu exklusiven Positionen im Maschinen- und Anlagenbau mit internationalem Umfeld.
- Direkte Vermittlung in eine langfristige Festanstellung bei unserem Kunden.
- Vertrauliche und professionelle Betreuung mit transparenter Kommunikation.
- Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung auf Gespräche sowie während aller weiteren Prozessschritte.

Unser Kunde steht für technische Präzision, partnerschaftliche Zusammenarbeit und nachhaltige Lösungen im industriellen Umfeld. Durch langjährige Erfahrung in der Ventil- und Fluidtechnik bietet das Unternehmen stabile Strukturen, internationale Marktpräsenz und moderne Vertriebsprozesse. Mitarbeitende profitieren von kurzen Entscheidungswegen, hoher Eigenverantwortung und einem Umfeld, das Innovation, Teamgeist und persönliche Weiterentwicklung aktiv fördert.

title: Strategischer Einkäufer (m/w/d) eCommerce | Healthcare & Pharmazie - ROSSMANN-Apotheke B.V. (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
description:
Mit der Rossmann-Apotheke B.V. bauen wir ein neues Angebot im digitalen Gesundheitsmarkt auf: Eine vollwertige Apotheke, die einen einfachen, verantwortungsvollen und kundenorientierten Zugang zu Arzneimitteln und apothekennaher Gesundheitsversorgung ermöglichen wird. Dabei verbinden wir die Sicherheit eines krisenfesten Unternehmens mit der Dynamik eines modernen E-Commerce- und Logistikumfelds.

In der Rolle unterstützen Sie den Aufbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke von Anfang an mit. Statt bestehende Strukturen zu verwalten, entwickeln Sie als Dienstleister für die Apotheke neue Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Sortimentsstrategien und Wachstumsfelder für ein Geschäftsfeld mit hoher strategischer Bedeutung.

Das bewirken Sie bei uns

Als Strategischer Einkäufer (m/w/d) eCommerce | Healthcare & Pharmazie übernehmen Sie die strategische Verantwortung für ausgewählte Sortimentsbereiche der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Sie entwickeln Lieferantenpartnerschaften, Preis- und Sortimentsstrategien und leisten einen wesentlichen Beitrag zum Wachstum eines zukunftsorientierten Geschäftsfeldes. Dabei agieren Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Markt, Herstellern und internen Fachbereichen.

- Sortimentsstrategie:  Sie bauen unsere pharmazeutischen Sortimente im eCommerce kontinuierlich auf und identifizieren neue Umsatz-, Markt- und Wachstumspotenziale zur Etablierung auf dem Markt
- Lieferantenentwicklung:  Sie bauen strategische Partnerschaften auf, entwickeln erste Kooperationen weiter und gestalten die zukünftige Lieferantenstruktur aktiv mit
- Verhandlungen:  Sie führen Jahresgespräche sowie Preis-, Konditions- und Vertragsverhandlungen und erzielen nachhaltige Ergebnisse für unser Geschäft
- Preisstrategie:  Sie analysieren Markt-, Sortiments- und Wettbewerbsentwicklungen und leiten daraus fundierte Preis- und Handlungsempfehlungen ab
- Geschäftsentwicklung:  Sie begleiten den Ausbau der ROSSMANN-Apotheke und wirken aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung strategischer Beschaffungs- und Vermarktungskonzepte mit, dabei bringen Sie ihre Ideen proaktiv ein
- Schnittstellenmanagement:  Gemeinsam mit internen Stakeholdern aus dem Marketing und dem Management der Apotheke entwickeln Sie erfolgreiche Wachstumsinitiativen für das eCommerce-Geschäft der ROSSMANN-Apotheke. Durch Ihre Persönlichkeit schaffen Sie es sich ein Netzwerk in der Pharmabranche aufzubauen
- Innovation:  Sie treiben Zukunftsthemen wie den Ausbau von Direktbezugsmodellen und die Entwicklung neuer Lieferantenstrategien im Apothekenumfeld voran

Das bringen Sie mit

- Qualifikation:  Ihre Basis ist ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Betriebswirtschaft, Gesundheitsökonomie, Pharmazie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Berufserfahrung:  Sie bringen mehrjährige Erfahrung im strategischen Einkauf, Category Management oder im Lieferantenmanagement mit und haben bereits Verantwortung für Sortimente, Umsatz- oder Geschäftsentwicklung übernommen
- Branchenverständnis:   Idealerweise verfügen Sie über Erfahrungen im Pharma-, Healthcare-, Apotheken-, Handels- oder FMCG-Umfeld
- Verhandlungsgeschick:  Sie überzeugen durch eine hohe Abschlussstärke und haben Erfahrung in der Führung anspruchsvoller Lieferanten- und Vertragsverhandlungen
- Analysekompetenz:   Auf Basis von Kennzahlen, Marktanalysen und wirtschaftlichen Rahmenbedingungen treffen Sie Entscheidungen
- Unternehmerisches Denken und Innovationsgeist:   Sie verfügen über die Fähigkeit, Chancen in dynamischen Märkten zu identifizieren, innovative Konzepte zu entwickeln und diese erfolgreich in nachhaltige Geschäftserfolge zu überführen
- Reisebereitschaft:  Den persönlichen Austausch mit Geschäftspartnern schätzen Sie und bringen die Bereitschaft für Dienstreisen mit

title: Kwaliteitscoördinator (m/v) - vakantieparken NL
description:
Ben jij nauwkeurig, communicatief en heb je oog voor kwaliteit? Zoek je een job waarin je mensen kunt coachen én zelf actief op de werkvloer staat? Dan ben jij misschien onze nieuwe kwaliteitscoördinator schoonmaak. Wij zoeken een kwaliteitscoördinator schoonmaak (m/v) die mee instaat voor het bewaken en verbeteren van onze schoonmaakkwaliteit van drie vakantieparken in Nieuwvliet-Bad (NL).

Als kwaliteitscoördinator ben je een belangrijke schakel tussen onze medewerkers en de kwaliteit die we onze klanten beloven. Je begeleidt en coacht schoonmaakmedewerkers, voert kwaliteitscontroles uit en helpt hen om hun werk steeds beter te doen.

Maar vooral: je bent niet bang om zelf de handen uit de mouwen te steken. Je staat tussen je collega's op de werkvloer, helpt mee met de schoonmaak en springt bij waar nodig.

34 uur per week: deeltijdse betrekking - verdeeld over vier dagen: maandag, donderdag, vrijdag en zaterdag. Je hebt vast vrij op dinsdag, woensdag en zondag.

Maandag 07u45 – 17u15
Grote wisseldag - opstart OA, controles, klachtenopvolging

Donderdag 07u45 – 17u15
Voorbereiding wissel vrijdag, controles, materiaal & linnen

Vrijdag 07u45 – 17u15
Grote wisseldag - opstart OA, controles, klachtenopvolging

Zaterdag 09u00 – 16u30
Opstart, begeleiding en controle van de weekendploegen

Dinsdag, woensdag, zondag ben je vrij

Flexibiliteit hoort bij deze job. Wissels lopen niet altijd zoals gepland: het gebeurt dat er 's avonds of op zondag nog een wijziging moet doorgegeven worden aan een ploeg. Je bent dan bereikbaar en handelt wat nodig is. In ruil krijg je drie vaste vrije dagen per week, waaronder de zondag.

Tussen 15 juli en 15 augustus is verlof nauwelijks in te plannen - dat is onze drukste periode. Daarbuiten is er ruimte, in overleg met de collega's.

Je hebt een uitzonderlijk oog voor detail - je ziet wat een ander over het hoofd ziet. Je werkt zelfstandig, nauwkeurig en eerlijk.

Je kan kwaliteitsstandaarden helder communiceren naar mensen met heel verschillende achtergronden.

Je denkt in oplossingen, stelt prioriteiten wanneer niet alles tegelijk kan, en escaleert tijdig in plaats van alles zelf te willen oplossen. Je bent betrouwbaar, stipt en paraat - de ploegen rekenen op jou bij de opstart. Je bent flexibel en kan je uurrooster aanpassen aan de noden van de job.

Je woont bij voorkeur binnen een straal van 30 minuten rond Nieuwvliet-Bad. Je hebt een rijbewijs B.

Talen: je spreekt vlot Nederlands en Engels. Kennis van Pools of Turks is een pluspunt - daarmee bereik je onze ploegen rechtstreeks.

Ervaring in schoonmaak, facility of hospitality is een pluspunt - evenals ervaring met het aansturen of opvolgen van ploegen.

Je kan vlot overweg met Excel en digitale planningssystemen.

Omdat je de sleutels van alle vakantiewoningen beheert, vragen we een recente Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (NL) of bewijs van goed zedelijk gedrag (BE)

title: Juridisch Medewerker Omgevingsvergunningen
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor de gemeente Sittard-Geleen een juridisch medewerker omgevingsvergunningen.

Met jouw juridische blik zorg jij voor vertrouwen in onze vergunningprocessen. Je brengt duidelijkheid in complexe vraagstukken en helpt mee aan een gemeente waarin ruimte is voor initiatief.

Als juridisch medewerker omgevingsvergunningen werk je aan vraagstukken die direct invloed hebben op de leefomgeving van Sittard-Geleen. Je adviseert over complexe vergunningdossiers, weegt verschillende belangen af en vertaalt wet- en regelgeving naar juridisch zorgvuldig onderbouwde besluiten. Zo draag je bij aan een gemeente waarin inwoners, ondernemers en bestuur kunnen rekenen op duidelijke en betrouwbare besluitvorming.

Je komt terecht in een veelzijdige en betekenisvolle functie binnen Team vergunningen, parkeren, markten & havens (VPM&H). Geen dossier is hetzelfde en juist die afwisseling maakt jouw werk uitdagend. Je krijgt de ruimte om jouw juridische expertise in te zetten voor maatschappelijke vraagstukken die zichtbaar zijn in de dagelijkse praktijk.

Als juridisch medewerker omgevingsvergunningen krijg je energie van complexe juridische vraagstukken en het vinden van oplossingen die recht doen aan verschillende belangen. Je weegt belangen zorgvuldig af en vertaalt wet- en regelgeving naar heldere adviezen en goed onderbouwde besluiten. Daarbij schakel je moeiteloos tussen inwoners, ondernemers, collega’s en bestuur.

Herken jij jezelf hierin? Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

  • Je begeleidt vergunningaanvragen en adviseert over complexe juridische vraagstukken binnen het omgevingsrecht, horeca, evenementen en bijzondere wetten.
  • Je behandelt zelfstanding bezwaar-, beroep- en hogerberoepszaken en draagt bij aan zorgvuldige, transparante en juridisch houdbare besluitvorming.
  • Je beoordeelt aanvragen op juridische haalbaarheid, stelt goed gemotiveerde besluiten op en vertaalt nieuwe wet- en regelgeving en jurisprudentie naar de dagelijkse praktijk.
  • Je communiceert helder met aanvragers, bezwaarmakers, collega’s, bestuur en ketenpartners en weet juridische informatie begrijpelijk over te brengen.
  • Je krijgt energie van het samenwerken met collega’s aan verbeteringen binnen het domein en neemt hierin ook zelf het initiatief.
  • Je staat stevig in een discussie en durft je eigen standpunt te verdedigen. Tegelijkertijd heb je oog voor de standpunten van anderen en kom je ook voor hun belangen op wanneer dat nodig is.

Ervaring binnen de vergunningverlening is mooi meegenomen, maar jouw juridische basis, leervermogen en motivatie vinden wij minstens zo belangrijk.

Veerkrachtig Vooruit

Jij komt terecht binnen Team Vergunningen, Parkeren, Markten & Havens. Hier werken verschillende disciplines samen aan vraagstukken die inwoners, ondernemers en de stad direct raken. Van vergunningverleners en juristen tot collega’s uit andere vakgebieden: iedereen brengt vanuit zijn eigen expertise kennis en ervaring in om tot goede oplossingen te komen.

Binnen het team zoeken we elkaar op, delen we kennis en staan we voor elkaar klaar. Complexe vraagstukken pakken we samen aan, waarbij we oog houden voor zowel de juridische kaders als de praktische gevolgen van onze besluiten.

Met jouw juridische kennis, scherpe blik en verbindende aanpak help je om onze gemeente te voorzien van zorgvuldige besluiten, betrouwbare vergunningverlening en heldere juridische kaders. Je krijgt hier de ruimte om te groeien, initiatief te nemen en iedere dag bij te dragen aan een gemeente die menselijker, duurzamer en een beetje beter wordt. Dát is Veerkrachtig Vooruit.

  • Je beschikt over een afgeronde juridische hbo- of wo-opleiding en hebt ervaring met bestuursrecht, omgevingsrecht en/of bijzondere wetten, zoals de Alcoholwet.
  • Je bent analytisch, zorgvuldig en oplossingsgericht. Je neemt initiatief, werkt graag samen en krijgt energie van een dynamische omgeving waarin geen dag hetzelfde is.

title: Toezichthouder Civiele Techniek
description:

title: Senior Casemanager Omgevingsvergunningen
description:
Grensarbeid zoekt voor de gemeente Sittard-Geleen een Senior Casemanager Omgevingsvergunningen

Wat jou past in deze functie

Je krijgt energie van het werken aan complexe vergunningaanvragen binnen het fysieke domein, waarbij jouw inhoudelijke beoordeling direct bijdraagt aan een zorgvuldige en rechtmatige besluitvorming. Je houdt overzicht, bewaakt de voortgang en neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor dossiers. Je weet wanneer je zelfstandig beslissingen kunt nemen en wanneer samenwerking of advies nodig is.

Als Senior Casemanager Omgevingsvergunningen:

  • Vind je het leuk om (multi)complexe aanvragen te analyseren en te beoordelen binnen het wettelijke kader van de Omgevingswet, zodat inwoners en ondernemers weten waar zij aan toe zijn
  • Krijg je energie van het toetsen aan het Omgevingsplan en het Besluit Bouwwerken Leefomgeving (BBL), en het zorgvuldig afwegen van planologische en juridische belangen in concrete dossiers
  • Heb je interesse in het toepassen van beleidsregels rondom het planologisch afwijken van het omgevingsplan, waarbij je bijdraagt aan consistente en uitlegbare besluitvorming
  • Vind je het belangrijk om specialistische klantvragen inhoudelijk goed te behandelen en zo bij te dragen aan vertrouwen in de gemeentelijke dienstverlening
  • Werk je graag samen met juristen en collega’s aan bezwaar- en beroepsprocedures, omdat je staat voor kwaliteit, zorgvuldigheid en een sterke juridische onderbouwing
  • Krijg je energie van het adviseren van management en bestuur over vergunningverlening en ruimtelijke vraagstukken, juist wanneer dossiers bestuurlijk of maatschappelijk gevoelig zijn;
  • Heb je hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en affiniteit met of ervaring binnen het fysieke domein en de Omgevingswet
  • Ben je resultaatgericht, houdt je overzicht, en neem je eigenaarschap over je dossiers van start tot besluit.

Team Vergunningen, Parkeren, Markten en Havens

Team Vergunningen, Parkeren, Markten en Havens (VPM&H) kiest bewust voor een volgende stap in professionalisering. Met de groeiende complexiteit van maatschappelijke en ruimtelijke vraagstukken bouwen we aan een dienstverlening die voorspelbaar, zorgvuldig en toekomstbestendig is voor inwoners en ondernemers.

Daarom openen we meerdere vacatures tegelijk binnen hetzelfde team. Of je nu al ruime ervaring hebt of juist toe bent aan een volgende stap: je komt terecht in een omgeving waar vakmanschap, samenwerking en ontwikkeling centraal staan. Je krijgt de ruimte om impact te maken op dossiers die ertoe doen én om mee te bouwen aan hoe we ons werk organiseren, nu en in de toekomst.

“Wat ik belangrijk vind in ons team, is dat mensen hun vak goed kunnen uitoefenen én zich daarin blijven ontwikkelen. We werken aan duidelijke processen en stevige kwaliteit, maar altijd met oog voor de praktijk en voor elkaar. Als je het leuk vindt om inhoudelijk scherp te werken en tegelijk mee te bouwen aan hoe we het samen beter organiseren, dan pas je goed bij ons en ontmoeten we je graag.” – A.I Teammanager Vergunningen, Parkeren, Markten en Havens

Wat jou veerkrachtig maakt:

Je krijgt energie van afwisseling en van een rol waarin je zelf de regie neemt. Je houdt overzicht, denkt in mogelijkheden en weet verschillende belangen bij elkaar te brengen. Tegelijkertijd verlies je de regels en de bestuurlijke context niet uit het oog. Je bent duidelijk in je communicatie, werkt graag samen en voelt je verantwoordelijk voor het resultaat.

Herken jij jezelf ook in de volgende zaken? Dan kunnen we niet wachten om je te leren kennen!

  • Je beschikt over minimaal hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur in planologie, juridisch of een vergelijkbare richting
  • Je hebt ervaring met het begeleiden van vergunningtrajecten en het adviseren over ruimtelijke vraagstukken
  • Je bent resultaatgericht, gestructureerd en houdt de voortgang scherp in de gaten
  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en weet wanneer je zelfstandig handelt of juist de samenwerking zoekt
  • Je bent omgevingsbewust en hebt gevoel voor bestuurlijke verhoudingen en verschillende belangen
  • Je kunt complexe informatie helder uitleggen aan inwoners, ondernemers en andere betrokkenen
  • Je kent de relevante wet- en regelgeving, waaronder de Omgevingswet, en vindt het interessant om ontwikkelingen binnen het vakgebied te volgen.

title: Experienced Junior Graphic Designer - Scale-up company
description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. Furthermore, the candidate must have experience executing designs within strict corporate B2B brand guidelines and working directly with technical specifications from global manufacturers.

About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

The Role: Graphic & Visual Designer
We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

What We Offer:
A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.
